en.headline: 18 own commits, 20 automated commits, and one issue interaction
en.summary: Across `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, and `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, there were **18 own commits**, plus 20 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`; 0 pull requests and 0 reviews were recorded. The 11 own commits in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` covered CI probe cleanup, the `opencode-go-minimax` provider leg, `reasoning_effort=low`, codemap baselines, and a temporary probe workflow; the 6 in `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` added an MV3 skeleton, page-only translation, state resets, smoke tests, JSDoc checking, and `AGENTS.md`; the 1 in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` documented `openchamber-storage` procedures. The issues total is 1 opened or closed issue; the recorded activity was commenting on `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` issue #8, “[ai-failure] AI 叙述生成失败,” which had 5 comments at collection time. Separately, `btriapitsyn` closed `openchamber/openchamber` issue #5293, “[Bug] Project actions menu: Auto-discover dev server runs the first saved action instead of discovering a server.”

zh.headline: 18 次本人提交、20 次自动提交及一项 issue 互动
zh.summary: 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`、`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 和 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 共完成 **18 次本人提交**，另有 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交 20 次；记录到 0 个拉取请求和 0 次评审。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 11 次本人提交涉及清理 CI 探针、增加 `opencode-go-minimax` provider 链路、使用 `reasoning_effort=low`、更新 codemap 基线及临时探针 workflow；`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 的 6 次提交增加 MV3 骨架、仅保留页面翻译、重置页面状态、加入冒烟测试与 JSDoc 检查，并新增 `AGENTS.md`；`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 1 次提交记录了 `openchamber-storage` 流程。issue 总计为新开或关闭 1 个 issue；实际活动是在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` issue #8“[ai-failure] AI 叙述生成失败”中发表评论，采集时该 issue 共 5 条评论。此外，`btriapitsyn` 关闭了 `openchamber/openchamber` issue #5293“[Bug] Project actions menu: Auto-discover dev server runs the first saved action instead of discovering a server”。
